title: Local pure tensors in internal sheaf modules
statement: Let $C$ be a category with object universe $v$ and morphism universe $w$, and $J$ a Grothendieck topology. Let abelian groups take values in universe $u$, with $\max(v,w)\le u$. Assume abelian sheafification exists and its local equivalences are monoidal. Give $\operatorname{Sh}(C,\operatorname{Ab})$ its sheafified objectwise tensor over $\mathbf Z$ [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure]. Let $R$ be a commutative ring object and $M,N$ internal $R$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], with their coequalizer relative tensor [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor]. For $U\in C$ and sections $x\in M(U)$, $y\in N(U)$, define $\operatorname{internalPureTensor}_{R,U}(x,y)\in(M\otimes_RN)(U)$ to be the image of $x\otimes_{\mathbf Z}y$ under the lax monoidal comparison for the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves, followed by the relative-tensor coequalizer projection. This is the same section pairing for every such site, in particular for the coherent profinite site and for a scheme's small pro-etale site; it is not restricted to the latter.
